name: Strategist
selection_note: Selected before final testing. Of three candidates compared on the same 128 fresh development seeds, this export had the highest weaker-target score, no rally losses to either target, and the highest paired match win rate against the attacker (111/128). All final seeds were untouched.
architecture: Fixed ReLU trajectory features from the original six inputs; learned 8→128→128→64→1 Tanh target head; fixed linear paddle feedback emits up/stay/down scores.
